comment: Signing in with an email and a password (src/passwords.mjs). kdf is the memory-hard way a password is kept: scrypt with cost n, block size r, parallelism p and a key of key_bytes from a random salt of salt_bytes; it is stored beside each kept password, so raising it later re-keeps each password the next time it signs in. kdf_bounds is the weakest and the costliest a kept record's kdf may say: a record outside them (tampered, or from a weaker past) never signs in, so nobody can lower the work a password check costs or make one check take the whole Worker. min_length and max_length bound a new password. tries limits sign-in tries per network address and per email within window_minutes. reset_minutes is how long a reset code works (the code itself is the sign-in code of src/sign-in-email.mjs, bound to resetting). strength rates a new password as it is typed (src/password-strength.mjs): score 0 is shorter than min_length, and each of 12 characters or more, and three kinds of character (lower case, upper case, digits, others), adds one. words are everything a person reads.

strength.said: Fine. A longer password is stronger.

words.wrong: That email and password don't match. Try again, or choose Forgot password.
words.too_many: Too many tries. Wait {minutes} minutes, then try again, or choose Forgot password.
words.too_short: Use at least {min} characters for your password.
words.too_long: Use at most {max} characters for your password.
words.not_an_email: Type the email address you sign in with.
words.taken: There is already a Trillion account with this email. Sign in instead, or choose Forgot password.
words.taken_by_other: Another Trillion account signs in with this email. Use a different email.
words.unreachable: No email can reach {email}. Check the address you typed.
words.sign_up_sent: We emailed a {digits}-digit code to confirm your email. It works for {minutes} minutes. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
words.reset_subject: Your Trillion code to reset your password: {code}
words.reset_sent: If this email has a Trillion account, a {digits}-digit code is on its way. It works for {minutes} minutes. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
words.reset_done: Your new password is set. Opening Trillion…
words.removed: Your password is removed. Sign in with a passkey or a code from now on.
words.last_way_in: Your password is your only way to sign in. Add a passkey first, then remove it.
words.not_the_same: The two new passwords are not the same. Type it again.
words.current_wrong: Your current password is not right. Type it again, or choose Forgot password.
